clearedSpotChecks.check: Upcoming forks over the next six months: announced or staged HyperEVM upgrades, and what an ordinary account could do on the day after a move to Prague or Osaka rules.
clearedSpotChecks.note: On 2026-11-27 an eth_call on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm of code 0x60011e5f5260205ff3 (CLZ) returned 'EVM error: NotActivated', and eth_getCode and an eth_call at 0x0b returned 0x. nanoreth master src/evm/spec.rs (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hl-archive-node/nanoreth/master/src/evm/spec.rs, fetched) maps V1 and V2 to SpecId::CANCUN. V2 is described as 'MRB precompile accounting and Osaka ModExp'. The cleared item does not mention this, and it does not matter: src/ calls no MODEXP precompile. A search of src/ outside src/test for tx.origin, gasleft, extcodesize, extcodehash, code.length, block fields and blobhash finds nothing. gas() appears only as the forwarded gas argument of call (src/types/Currency.sol:48, 73; src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134) and address(this).balance only in balanceOfSelf (src/types/Currency.sol:92), which native settle does not use.

clearedSpotChecks.check: L-1143: the borrows of the unchecked subtractions in getFeeGrowthInside (src/libraries/Pool.sol:498-509) and of the fee growth difference in Position.update (src/libraries/Position.sol:91-96).
clearedSpotChecks.note: The lines match: Pool.sol:497-509 is an unchecked block with the three branches, and Position.sol:91-96 subtracts feeGrowthInside*LastX128 inside unchecked before FullMath.mulDiv. out/borrow.json has the three scripts with 33 calls in the first, no failed calls, and words near 2^256 (for example ffffffffffffffffd6fca951...), so the borrow really occurs. These are the wrapping SUB and MULMOD paths. I ran my own MULMOD, ADDMOD, SDIV and SMOD edge vectors on the official node: mulmod with 2^256-1 operands and moduli 2^255+1, 2^256-1, 2^255-19 and 3, addmod overflowing 2^256, sdiv(-2^255,-1) and smod(-2^255,-1). All returned the specified words, and the result agrees with the cleared item.

clearedSpotChecks.check: L-1154: which block state latest serves on the official endpoint.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I ran eth_getBlockByNumber on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm on 2026-11-27. latest and safe returned 52,338,855 (0x730d2d72...), finalized one call later returned 52,338,856 as the chain advanced, and pending returned null. web3_clientVersion is 'hyperliquid evm Mainnet'. PoolManager code is 24,009 bytes with sha256 prefix 907b85e610ad5dab, as networks.json says. Transient storage on the same node works: tstore(1,7) then tload(1) returned 7. This item is operator level in any case. I also checked the repeated pmdiff2 exception, script 189. Earlier cycles explained it as gas only, since it is identical at 30 million gas (cleared, cycle 10 and cycle 17). It is a liveness note and has no arithmetic difference.
